name: Maintainer – Maintenance Mode & Coming Soon Pages
author: MatterWP

sections.description:
Maintainer is an easy-to-use, feature-packed WordPress solution for creating maintenance mode and coming soon pages. It’s designed to be fast and simple, letting you build sleek maintenance pages, upcoming launch announcements, and under-construction notices—without slowing down your site.

High-Performance Architecture

  • Optimized code with zero impact on site performance
  • Loads only when maintenance mode is active
  • Lightweight implementation with no external dependencies
  • Blazing-fast page delivery

Professional Customization Options

  • Intuitive settings dashboard for quick configuration
  • Fully customizable heading and subheading text
  • Professional design templates ready for immediate use
  • Custom page titles and meta descriptions
  • Nine carefully crafted color schemes

Advanced Features for Developers

  • IP address whitelist system
  • Role-based access controls
  • Custom bypass URL parameters
  • SEO optimization settings
  • Clean, validated HTML output

Enterprise-Grade Security

  • WordPress security best practices implementation
  • Properly sanitized and escaped output
  • Minimal server resource utilization
  • Regular security updates and maintenance

Perfect Solution For:

  • Website maintenance periods
  • Pre-launch landing pages
  • Coming soon announcements
  • Under construction notices
  • Temporary site offline states
  • Agency development workflows

Built for WordPress Professionals

  • Compatible with latest WordPress versions
  • Multisite ready
  • Advanced SEO controls
  • IP verification system
  • Comprehensive documentation

Transform your maintenance mode experience with a solution trusted by professionals. Whether you’re an agency, developer, or site owner, Maintainer provides the tools you need for effective site maintenance communication.
sections.faq:
How do I manage maintenance mode?

Access and control maintenance mode through:

  1. WordPress admin toolbar quick toggle
  2. Settings → Maintainer control panel

What access control options are available?

Maintainer offers three bypass methods:

  1. Role-Based Access – Specify WordPress user roles
  2. IP Whitelist – Allow specific IP addresses
  3. URL Parameters – Custom access codes via URL

What customization features are included?

Comprehensive customization options:

  • Primary and secondary headings
  • Custom page titles
  • Meta description control
  • SEO configuration options
  • Multiple color schemes
  • Custom CSS support

Is Maintainer optimized for search engines?

Maintainer implements complete SEO best practices:

  • Customizable meta information
  • Search engine visibility controls
  • Semantic HTML structure
  • Clean code output
  • Proper data sanitization
